name: ASUS router (AiMesh)
author: Netlens
description: Reads which device is connected to which AiMesh node (stock ASUSWRT, tested on an RT-AX92U) so the hierarchy and the map show every client's real network position. Read-only: one login, two reads and a logout per sync, never SSH, so no sessions are left open on the router. A refused login pauses automatic syncing so the router does not lock the account.

config.label: Router address
config.help: The router's web interface. HTTPS defaults to port 8443.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Leave off: ASUS routers use a self-signed certificate.
